import unittest
import weakref
from conftest import trace

references = []


class Token:
    def __del__(self):
        trace("unconsumed-error-token-destroyed")


class CarriedError(ValueError):
    def __init__(self, token):
        self.token = token
        references.append(weakref.ref(token))
        super().__init__("third-unconsumed-error")


def late_cleanup():
    raise CarriedError(Token())


def early_cleanup():
    raise ValueError("second-consumed-error")


class LifetimeCase(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.addCleanup(late_cleanup)
        self.addCleanup(early_cleanup)

    def test_body(self):
        pass

    def tearDown(self):
        raise RuntimeError("first-consumed-error")
